pages.text: Silver ore is found underground and can be smelted into silver ingots. It is a key crafting material for many mod recipes.$(br)
Silver ingots are used in satchels, soul gems, infused pickaxes, and many other recipes.$(br)

pages.title: Uses
pages.text: Silver is used in many recipes throughout the mod, including:$(br2)$(li)$(bold)Satchels$() for storing and transporting items$(br)$(li)$(bold)Soul Gems$() for capturing and storing souls$(br)$()

pages.title: Uses
pages.text: $(li)$(bold)Infused Pickaxe$() for mining special ores$(br)$(li)$(bold)Ritual Satchels$() for automating rituals$(br)$(li)$(bold)Familiar Rings$() for binding familiars$(br)$(li)And many more!$()

pages.title: Uses
pages.text: $(br2)Silver can also be obtained from $(bold)crusher$() spirit jobs.$(br)
